Subject: Onboarding/PO: EdgeWorks / Redwood — payment terms & onboarding forms

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the warm welcome — excited to get EdgeWorks set up as a Redwood vendor. Attached is our completed onboarding form and a copy of our standard payment terms for your records. A couple of items I want to flag so we can avoid surprises on the first invoice:

- Our finance team typically invoices Net60 to allow for their receivable processing; we can accept Net45 if Redwood requires tighter cadence.
- If possible, we’d like to request an expedited payment on the first invoice (Net30 or earlier) while we complete the vendor portal onboarding — helps our cash flow during the initial ramp.

Can you confirm what PO cadence Redwood uses and whether AP can make a one-time accelerated payment for the first invoice? Also please let me know which forms/bank docs you still need from us.

Hi Alec — great to meet you. Thanks for sending the completed onboarding form. Quick answers below and next steps so we can get the first invoice flowing.

- Standard Redwood policy is Net30 for vendor payments. Exceptions are handled case-by-case by AP with manager sign-off.
- We can offer a one-time expedited settlement on the first invoice (we typically do Net10 for an expedite) if EdgeWorks is willing to accept a small settlement fee or an early-pay discount. Typical options we offer: 2% discount if paid in 10 days (2% 10), or a one-time expedited payment without discount depending on the vendor relationship.
- PO cadence: we issue POs ahead of the invoice cycle and mark the expected billing frequency on the PO (monthly/quarterly). I will provision PO RWD-2026-051 pending the completed ACH/W9 and the signed PO template.

Action items for EdgeWorks: please upload bank details/ACH form and a signed W9 to the vendor portal link below. Once AP receives that and the signed PO I will request the expedite for the first invoice.

Vendor portal invite: https://redwood.app/vendor-portal/invite/edgeworks-123
PO template (attached): PO_Template_Redwood.xlsx
DocuSign for ACH/W9 link (if you prefer): https://docusign.com/link/abc12345

CCing Laura (AP) and Marcus (vendor ops) to coordinate the PO and the expedited payment approval.

Thanks,

Hi Alec / team — Laura from AP here. Quick note on policy and what I can approve at my level: 

- Redwood standard: Net30. Any standing change to Net45/Net60 requires VP/senior finance approval and typically a procurement justification.
- For new vendors, AP can approve a one-time expedited payment on the first invoice if we have completed vendor setup (ACH + W9 + signed PO). The expedite option is usually Net10 and we ask vendors to accept a small settlement discount if they are requesting acceleration; 2% 10 is most common.

Proposal we can approve without escalation:
1) Issue PO RWD-2026-051 today.
2) EdgeWorks returns ACH + signed W9 via DocuSign link.
3) AP will schedule a one-time expedited payment for invoice #1 to be paid Net10 with a 2% early-pay discount, provided EdgeWorks signs the PO and returns the ACH form.

If EdgeWorks needs Net45 as a standing term, we will need to route to VP Finance and that will add ~4–6 business days for approval. Given your request to accelerate cash on the first invoice, the expedite + 2% option is faster.

DocuSign (ACH/W9): https://docusign.com/link/abc12345
PO PDF (attached): RWD_PO_RWD-2026-051.pdf

Let me know if you accept the expedite + 2% 10 and I'll mark the PO and queue the payment.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
AP Manager, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Alec — thank you for the quick turnaround. Confirming the following so we have a single record for finance and vendor ops:

- One-time expedited settlement for invoice #1: Redwood will execute Net10 on invoice #1 if EdgeWorks accepts a 2% early-pay discount (2% 10).
- Recurring terms after onboarding: Net30 (standard Redwood vendor terms). If EdgeWorks still prefers Net45 as a standing exception, we can pursue VP approval but that will take additional time; please indicate if you want us to start that route.
- Required docs: signed PO (attached), ACH form, and W9 uploaded to DocuSign link by EOD so Laura can validate.

Next steps (from here):
1) EdgeWorks confirms acceptance of 2% 10 for invoice #1 and uploads ACH + W9.
2) Marcus will release PO RWD-2026-051 in the vendor portal and confirm expected invoice window.
3) Laura will mark the expedite in AP and schedule payment once invoice is received and vendor docs are validated.
